description: Guard 2021/yumi-dynamic against empty-array and empty-set max expressions that modern MiniZinc rejects during evaluation.
rationale: Some challenge instances encode no suction order columns or empty zone sets. Older MiniZinc accepted the model shape, but current MiniZinc errors on max(empty).

replacements.replacement: int: no_suction_picks = if card(index_set_1of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_1of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) endif;
int: suction_order_lengths = if card(index_set_2of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_2of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) endif;
int: gripper_order_lengths = if card(index_set_2of2(gripper_pick_tasks_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_2of2(gripper_pick_tasks_orders)) endif;
int: no_fixtures = if card(index_set_1of2(fixture_task_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_1of2(fixture_task_orders)) endif;
int: fixture_order_lengths = if card(index_set_2of2(fixture_task_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_2of2(fixture_task_orders)) endif;

replacements.pattern: int: max_lwait = max( [ max(e) | e in wait_zones_left_data]  );
replacements.replacement: int: max_lwait = if card(index_set(wait_zones_left_data)) = 0 then 0 else max([ if card(e) = 0 then 0 else max(e) endif | e in wait_zones_left_data ]) endif;

replacements.pattern: int: max_rwait = max( [ max(e) | e in wait_zones_right_data] );
replacements.replacement: int: max_rwait = if card(index_set(wait_zones_right_data)) = 0 then 0 else max([ if card(e) = 0 then 0 else max(e) endif | e in wait_zones_right_data ]) endif;

replacements.pattern: int: max_lwork = max( [ max(e) | e in work_zones_left_data]  );
replacements.replacement: int: max_lwork = if card(index_set(work_zones_left_data)) = 0 then 0 else max([ if card(e) = 0 then 0 else max(e) endif | e in work_zones_left_data ]) endif;

replacements.pattern: int: max_rwork = max( [ max(e) | e in work_zones_right_data] );
replacements.replacement: int: max_rwork = if card(index_set(work_zones_right_data)) = 0 then 0 else max([ if card(e) = 0 then 0 else max(e) endif | e in work_zones_right_data ]) endif;

semantics_note: The guards preserve the original maxima when collections are non-empty and use 0 only for degenerate empty collections that otherwise abort compilation.
